name: prompt-enhancer
description: A sparkle Enhance button and hotkey that rewrites your draft prompt in place: fitting skills, project details, decisions to ask you first, and what done looks like.

hotkey.title: Enhance hotkey
hotkey.description: Chord pressed in the prompt box, e.g. meta+e (Option+E on macOS terminals set to use Option as Meta), ctrl+shift+e. Empty turns the hotkey off.

model.title: Model that rewrites the draft
model.description: An alias (haiku, sonnet) or a full model id. A small model keeps each Enhance cheap.

maxSkills.title: Skills offered to the model
maxSkills.description: At most this many installed skills are sent with the draft, the best word matches first.
